concerns.text: The baseline neural‑teacher (ConvLSTM) and the student diffusion model have fundamentally different architectures and capacities (ConvLSTM vs ~50 M‑parameter diffusion). Comparing them isolates *both* teacher signal and model capacity, confounding the causal claim that a deterministic physics teacher can replace a neural teacher. To attribute performance differences to the teacher signal, the same student architecture should be trained with both physics‑teacher and neural‑teacher signals, or the baseline should use an architecture matched in capacity to the diffusion student.
